title: HNSD benchmark: taxonomic placement and sub-taxonomy construction for unseen species
description: Code, benchmark splits and reference results for evaluating how images of species that are absent from a reference set can be (1) detected as novel, (2) placed under the correct known taxon at the correct rank, and (3) organised into a new sub-taxonomy. Includes a 2,017-species iNaturalist 2021 benchmark with computed ground truth for every novel species, a BIOSCAN-5M benchmark with 2,914 real undescribed insect species, generalized category discovery baselines (SimGCD, HypCD) and all analysis scripts. Images and extracted features are not redistributed.
